headline: A new usage reset announced
sourceTimezone: Not provided; X timestamp recorded in UTC
scope: All paid Codex and ChatGPT Work users will receive a usage reset as compensation for the outage.

announcement.text:
o yes… we’re back in action and we’ll reset usage limits for all paid users across codex and ChatGPT work

sorry about the brief disruption!

(and yes we have a special spare codex when things are down to help us out)
announcement.translation:
好耶……服务恢复了，我们将为 Codex 和 ChatGPT Work 的所有付费用户重置使用额度。

抱歉造成这次短暂中断！

（没错，出故障时我们有一个特别的备用 Codex 来帮忙。）

note: “Compensation” is CRW’s summary of the outage, apology, and reset announcement. The post does not confirm completion or specify whether the reset is automatic or banked. The post timestamp is not an execution time.
